bucketName.description: Name of the S3 bucket where data is retained.

prefix.description: Optional path prefix within the bucket.

enableSSE.description: Enable server-side encryption for objects written to the bucket.

iamRoleARN.description: ARN of the IAM role RudderStack assumes to access the bucket.

roleBasedAuth.description: Selects assume-role authentication in the data plane. True for this IAM-role account definition.
